mentions.name: Lime Reader
mentions.description: A time-sorted aggregator of top posts from Hacker News, Tildes, Lobsters, Slashdot, Bear, and science, tech & programming related subreddits, focused on STEAMD topics (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Math, and Design). The backend is built in Swift using SQLite.
